item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect lows ranging from the middle twenties to the lower thirties with cloudy skies and periods of rain and snow likely, especially early, and little or no snow accumulation expected. Tomorrow, skies remain mostly cloudy with highs in the upper thirties to lower forties and a slight chance of light snow early, tapering off through the day. Precipitation chances decrease Friday night with mostly cloudy conditions and lows in the lower to upper twenties.
